therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with primary malignant brain tumors that have not responded to standard therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective response rate per RANO criteria at 12 months

results.effect_size: Objective response rate: 4/40 (10%) - 2 complete responses, 2 partial responses
results.dose_information: Daily doses of A10 and AS2-1 divided into six infusions given at 4-hourly intervals, with A10 followed immediately by AS2-1

context.duration: 12 months primary assessment, survival follow-up to 60 months
